scope: sampled visual review; not exhaustive frame-by-frame or all-episode verification
observations: Inspected all 16 saved plan images and all 16 saved interaction images. Paths render within the maze view. These qualitative samples do not establish collision-free planning or certify the remaining 112 episodes. All 128 episode metrics are included in quantitative tables.
